$description: Closed registry of section motion patterns + the closed shader preset enum. Each pattern has a const reducedMotionFallback. reducedMotionHandledInSource=false marks a REAL gap: the clone source has no prefers-reduced-motion rule at all, so the fallback is a requirement generated pages must implement (warn rule REDUCED_MOTION_UNHANDLED_IN_SOURCE).

none.description: No load/scroll/keyframe motion in the section body; at most hover/focus transitions.

grain-overlay-smil.description: Fixed scanlines/noise/rgb-fringe overlays; the #grainy feTurbulence seed animates via SMIL (10s, indefinite).
grain-overlay-smil.fallbackNote: No prefers-reduced-motion rule exists anywhere in src/ (grep -ri 'reduce' src finds only prose). This fallback is a design-repo REQUIREMENT for generated pages, not observed source behaviour.
